purpose: Audit whether the first residual controller-parameter adapter can be trained without downgrading into a toy or meaningless model.

ready_gates.name: official_newton_scripted_infant_prior
ready_gates.evidence: Phase 02/04 Newton Panda hydro scripted lift-hold runs passed visual/lift/hold/slip/drop/contact gates.

ready_gates.name: real_mass_friction_grid
ready_gates.evidence: Nominal, ordinary grid, and held-out scripted-feedback runs apply real Newton mass/friction provenance; strict metrics fail only on object acceleration.

ready_gates.name: held_out_generalization_cells
ready_gates.evidence: full_low and empty_high remain held-out evaluation cells.

ready_gates.name: contact_proxy_source
ready_gates.evidence: Phase 05 contact source manifest has status=pass, source_run_count=10, record_count=3600, generated_trex_fields=[].

ready_gates.name: curiosity_replay_ablation_baseline
ready_gates.evidence: Phase 03 replay output has status=pass and rollout_count=9.

ready_gates.name: residual_adapter_target_contract
ready_gates.evidence: Residual adapter and forward-model target contract is defined with status=target_contract_ready_training_not_started.

ready_gates.name: nonzero_residual_diagnostic_path
ready_gates.evidence: Run residual_label_source_sensitive_feedback_half_low_20260627_030145 produced feedback_trigger_count=241 and nonzero candidate.controller residual fields, but metrics failed on hold_duration_below_threshold and object_accel_above_threshold.

ready_gates.name: bounded_residual_label_sweep_started
ready_gates.evidence: Run residual_label_sweep_half_low_contact58_20260627_0310 produced feedback_trigger_count=241 and nonzero candidate.controller residual fields, but failed the formal hold-duration gate with longest_hold_s=0.9833333333333333.

ready_gates.name: best_current_residual_label_candidate
ready_gates.evidence: Run residual_label_sweep_half_low_contact58_gentle_20260627_0345 passed fresh official Newton sanity, automated and manual visual checks, nonzero feedback_trigger_count=241, lift_height_m=0.1518997997045517, hold_duration_s=2.7166640758514404, max_slip_m=0.002728142855700976, contact_loss_frames=0, and drop_from_max=0.0, but strict metrics still failed on object_accel_above_threshold with max_object_accel_m_s2=8.308707788010144.

blockers.name: no_fully_promoted_strict_residual_label_source
blockers.evidence: The best current gentle contact58 run restores lift/hold/drop/contact gates and nonzero residual labels, but strict metrics still fail only on object_accel_above_threshold.

blockers.name: object_acceleration_gate_not_recovered
blockers.evidence: The current strict threshold is max_object_accel_m_s2 <= 8.0; the best current candidate reports max_object_accel_m_s2=8.308707788010144.

blockers.name: no_approved_training_implementation
blockers.evidence: No faithful residual-adapter training implementation has been selected or reviewed; a placeholder MLP/policy must not be introduced as learned adaptation progress.

blockers.name: no_adapter_sanity_runner
blockers.evidence: No compute-side residual-adapter training runner exists with official Newton sanity, source-gate checks, held-out split enforcement, and report generation.

resolved_blockers.name: no_promoted_nonzero_residual_demonstrations
resolved_blockers.evidence: Run residual_label_sweep_half_low_contact58_gentle_20260627_0345 produced nonzero residual labels and passed lift/hold/drop/contact/visual gates, but is not fully promoted because strict metrics still fail on object_accel_above_threshold.

resolved_blockers.name: first_nonzero_residual_diagnostic_rejected
resolved_blockers.evidence: Run residual_label_source_sensitive_feedback_half_low_20260627_030145 produced feedback_trigger_count=241 but failed formal metrics with hold_duration_below_min, so it remains diagnostic-only.

resolved_blockers.name: contact58_sweep_diagnostic_rejected
resolved_blockers.evidence: Run residual_label_sweep_half_low_contact58_20260627_0310 preserved nonzero feedback labels but still failed the formal 2s hold gate, so it remains diagnostic-only.

allowed_next_routes.description: Use the gentle contact58 run as the starting point and adjust only ordinary-cell diagnostics to reduce max_object_accel_m_s2 below the strict threshold while preserving nonzero residual labels, lift, hold, drop, contact-loss, visual, and sanity gates.
Only after nonzero residual labels or an approved objective exist, implement the training runner with source gates, held-out split checks, and no T-Rex schema promotion.
If using diffusion policy, ACT, OpenPI, or another serious baseline, first audit official code/checkpoints and observation/action contracts.
